system.description: Some object, creature or circumstance fills you with dread far beyond ordinary fear; your Beast instinctively treats it as a dire threat. When confronted with the object of your fear, you must make a Courage Virtue Test at a difficulty of at least three Traits, more if the Narrator deems the circumstances severe. If you fail, you suffer the usual penalties of failed Courage and Rotschreck.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
